skill.name: wasmc-json
skill.description: Rust serde_json-backed construction, selection, atomic edits and typed reads; no Lib-local capacity ceilings.

apis.delta: WIT owns values. Memory is caller/runtime-owned; no per-Lib byte/count/depth/output quota. Missing, JSON null, type and integer-range errors remain distinct. Iterative index storage avoids recursive drop; no JSONPath or JSON Patch standard claim.
